subject.title: gateway tool not available to external-provider agent sessions

question: Should this issue wait for live current-main Windows/xAI/Grok reproduction before a repair PR is attempted for `gateway` visibility?
rationale: Source inspection shows the intended allowlist path, but the security-sensitive gateway tool and provider-specific report make it unsafe to infer the exact bug without live effective-inventory proof or maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Require live inventory proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open for a current-main xAI/Grok or equivalent external-provider `tools.effective` reproduction before changing gateway visibility behavior.

options.title: Approve a narrow source-level repair
options.body: Allow a focused PR to add provider/effective-inventory regression coverage and repair the shared filtering path if the failing condition can be demonstrated without changing owner-only invocation semantics.

options.title: Clarify as intentional owner-only behavior
options.body: If maintainers intend `gateway` to stay hidden for this external-provider path, close only after documenting the visibility rule and supported owner/admin alternative.

recommendation.title: Require live inventory proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for a current-main xAI/Grok or equivalent external-provider `tools.effective` reproduction before changing gateway visibility behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The effective inventory and `tools.effective` path is the central surface for deciding whether provider-backed sessions should see `gateway`.
